hints.title: Operation Log History
hints.text: Record each update operation as a historical log tuple [row1, col1, row2, col2, newValue].

hints.title: Reverse Inspection on Retrieval
hints.text: When querying getValue(row, col), scan the operations log from newest to oldest.

hints.title: Initial Grid Fallback
hints.text: If no update rectangle encompasses (row, col), return the value from the initial rectangle.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Appending to the operation history takes O(1) time, and query scans at most U past updates.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Modifying cells across the entire subrectangle takes O(R * C) per update, which is slow for frequent updates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Logging updates achieves O(1) update time while keeping query fast when queries are sparse.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizing lazy historical logging vs in-place eager matrix overwriting.
